generated.what_happened: Leader Formulas, LLC has issued a nationwide voluntary recall for one lot of its Rapture Pre-Workout supplement after FDA testing detected 1,3-dimethylamylamine (DMAA), an illegal synthetic stimulant. The ingredient is known to elevate blood pressure and can cause cardiovascular issues, including shortness of breath, chest tightness, and heart attacks. The recall affects 450-gram containers across three flavors sold through retail stores and the company's website between January 29, 2025, and May 25, 2026. Although no adverse health events have been reported, consumers are advised to immediately discontinue use and return the product for a full refund.
